extra.reason: Verified by Brady manually: full WebAuthn ceremony (registration + login) completed on webauthn.io in an Alloy-style CEF window after the TCC Info.plist fix. No Apple entitlement involved — confirms the no-entitlement passkey path end-to-end.

Root cause: applicationWillTerminate called CefShutdown() directly while CefBrowser instances were still alive (CEF requires CloseBrowser + OnBeforeClose for every browser first). Fixed by overriding -[NSApplication terminate:] in Sources/Bridge/BRWApplication.mm (matching CEF's own cefclient/cefsimple reference pattern) to force-close all browsers via a new BRWClientHandler registry (CloseAll/LiveCount), poll to completion on the existing +[BRWEngine doMessageLoopWork] tick via +requestShutdownWithCompletion:, then CefShutdown + exit(0). Note: the initial fix attempt used NSApplicationDelegate.applicationShouldTerminate + .terminateLater, which builds clean but deadlocks forever (confirmed via sample: AppKit's private terminateLater event loop never services BRWMessagePump's timer, so OnBeforeClose never arrives) -- CEF's reference apps explicitly document that applicationShouldTerminate is unsupported for this reason, hence the -terminate: override instead. Verified via 2 full automated quit cycles (2 profile-window processes, tabs open) with no new DiagnosticReports entry and clean process exit, before AGENTS.md was updated to require agents hand off UI testing to Brady -- see docs/ai-tasks/quit-crash-notes.md for the Test/Expect/Report hand-off for live multi-window verification.

Confirmed via code review (no OnBeforePopup override -- relies entirely on Chromium/Blink's built-in gesture-gated popup blocker) and corroborating earlier empirical test (unsolicited popup blocked, user-initiated popup opened as a real separate window). Genuinely free, no engineering needed.

Code review confirms no command-line switches or feature flags disable Chromium's default background-tab throttling anywhere in this app -- Blink's default behavior applies unmodified. Verify-only task satisfied non-interactively.
